_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Maintenance Training Materials
summary: Specifies the format and content of Maintenance Training Materials used to train personnel on calibration, repair, and restoration of procured equipment and to develop initial and continuing technician training.
use_relationship:
The Maintenance Training Material shall be used for training of the personnel responsible for the calibration, repair and restoration of equipment procured by the program office. The Maintenance Training material will be used by the Government to develop instructional material for the initial qualification and continuing training of technicians.
This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract SOW.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Maintenance Training Material shall be in contractor format.

children.title: Training material shall include an Instructor Guide, Presentation Material for use as a training aid and a Student Guide.
Each document shall include a cover page that contains the following information:
The activity the training was prepared for
The name of the vendor who prepared the training
Distribution Statement, Destruction Notices and Export Control Notices as applicable
Each document shall include a Table of Contents and List of References.
The training shall cover the following topic areas at a minimum:
Tools, equipment, and software necessary to perform maintenance and calibration
Instructor led hands on practical lessons
children.content: The training shall include instructor led hands on practical lessons covering the troubleshooting, disassembly and reassembly of the instrument and replacement of components. Where practical, faults will be introduced to replicate potential failures technicians or equipment user may encounter during normal operation and maintenance.

children.title: The Instructor Guide
children.content: The Instructor Guide shall include objectives, a course outline, lesson plan(s) to guide the instructor through the presentation material, instructor discussion points that complement the presentation materials, and questions and answers to conduct knowledge checks to assess student understanding at the end of each topic area. The Instructor Guide shall also include detailed instructions for conducting the hands on practical exercises.

children.title: The Presentation Material
children.content: The Presentation Material shall include objectives and the text, diagrams, tables, pictures, drawings and other elements necessary to adequately cover the topic areas from paragraph 2.4.

children.title: Drawings, pictures and diagrams shall include labels to identify key components.
Tables shall include column and row headings.
Legends shall be included to describe labels, symbols and color coding as appropriate.
The student guide
children.content: The student guide shall include objectives, a course outline, a reproduction of training presentation materials, areas for student note taking, and tasks sheets describing the hands on tasks that accompany the course.
